description: Run the rAPIdtools asset pipeline (SAM 3 detection, crops, regularization, optional Gemini grading) on a patch of a RAPID orthomosaic published on DesignSafe. Executes the examples/eaton_fire_designsafe.ipynb notebook with papermill on a Lonestar6 GPU node and archives the GeoJSON outputs, the executed notebook, and a manifest.

envVariables.description: Free-form text prompt for SAM 3, for example 'building', 'road', 'tree', 'vehicle'.
Approximate size of one asset in meters. Sets the SAM 3 patch size.
Side of the square patch clipped from the orthomosaic, in meters. The whole tile is never processed.
Pixel size of the patch in meters. The Eaton tiles are 0.019 m; 0.05 reads from the tile overviews and keeps a 200 m patch at 4,000 pixels. Set to 0 to keep the source resolution.
Patch center as 'lon,lat' in WGS84. Empty uses the center of the tile.
True runs SAM 3 on the RAPID patch. False detects on Bing imagery of the same footprint, which needs internet access from the compute node.

enum_values.False: Detect on Bing imagery of the same footprint

envVariables.description: True grades each asset crop with Gemini. Needs GOOGLE_API_KEY in inputs/secrets.env and internet access.
'all' runs the pipeline. 'patch' stops after the clip, which checks staging and data access in a minute without a GPU.
Image with rapidtools, papermill, and dapi (built from deploy/tapis/rapidtools-ls6/Dockerfile). docker:// is pulled at job start; an absolute path to a .sif on $WORK skips the pull.
Directory for Hugging Face model weights. Empty uses $WORK/rapidtools/hf-cache, which persists between jobs so SAM 3 downloads once.
Notebook to run instead of the bundled examples/eaton_fire_designsafe.ipynb. A file name inside the Extra inputs directory.

fileInputs.name: Orthomosaic
fileInputs.description: A GeoTIFF orthomosaic. The default is the smallest Eaton Fire tile in PRJ-5815 (4.7 GB). The patch is clipped from this file on the node.

fileInputs.name: Extra inputs
fileInputs.description: Optional directory with secrets.env (GOOGLE_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN), a replacement notebook, or a .sif image.
